candidates.change_summary: Replace the overflow check assert with a require that uses >= instead of >, changing acceptance of zero-value deposits and failing on equal-case differently.
Remove the arithmetic check altogether, allowing deposits without the previous assert guard.
Invert the check to require that the new balance is strictly less than the old balance, which will reject normal deposits and change observable balance after deposit calls.
Change update order: update balance before performing the assert check (which could cause assert to read the already-updated balance), altering behavior when assert would fail.
Add a rejection of zero-value deposits by requiring msg.value > 0, thereby making deposit(0) revert and changing observable post-call balances for zero-value calls.
